minutes.headline: Board approved two liquor license transfers, heard the fuel tank location dispute, and recommended 13 warrant articles
minutes.summary: Remote meeting. The board approved an all-alcohol license transfer with a pledge and returned a pizzeria license to its prior owner. It heard the DPW director, the chiefs and the Conservation Commission on the location of the town fuel tanks near Mopus Brook, with no action taken. It reviewed FY21 budget adjustments and the annual town meeting warrant articles, recommending some, removing some, and deferring the rest to next week.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted 4-0 to recommend a consensus list of annual town meeting warrant articles, after removing the collective bargaining, OPEB and PAC capital articles.
The board voted 4-0 to approve an all-alcohol restaurant license transfer with a pledge, and 4-0 to return a pizzeria license to its prior owner.
The board heard the DPW director, the chiefs and the Conservation Commission on where to site the town fuel tanks near Mopus Brook; no action was taken.
On a citizen petition for an additional liquor license, the board will ask town counsel whether the wording can be amended on the floor before voting to support it.
Held articles move to the May 12 meeting; the town manager evaluation was postponed until after the election.

why_it_matters: The recommended warrant articles are what residents will be asked to vote on at town meeting, and the deferred OPEB article and the FY21 budget adjustments bear on future tax bills.
The fuel tank location is undecided, so the cost and siting of a town facility near a brook remain open.
watch_next: May 12 Select Board meeting, which is to cover the remaining warrant articles.
Town counsel's answer on whether the citizen petition wording can be amended on the floor.
